name: codex-pro-dispatch
description: A fail-closed macOS desktop Codex workflow for dispatching one bounded assignment to a dedicated ChatGPT Pro conversation.

interface.longDescription: Desktop-only on the official ChatGPT app for macOS. Dispatch bounded work from Codex to a dedicated ChatGPT Pro conversation with at-most-one sends, collect-only recovery, and exact reassembly of long results from continuation chunks.
defaultPrompt: Delegate this bounded task to my ChatGPT Pro worker.
Ask my Pro worker for an independent code review.
Recover my current Pro dispatch without resending.
